extracted.name: Apple Dumpling Cookies
extracted.description: It’s a new way to bake apple pies!
instruction_lines: Cook the apples with sugar and cinnamon. Leave it to cool.
Mix butter, eggs, vanilla, sugar and corn starch in a big mixing bowl.
Add flour and baking powder and knead it to a soft dough. Add your flour gradually or separating 1/3s.
Shape the dough like dumplings. Fill them with the cool apple filling.
Bake the cookies in the oven set for 180°C or 350°F until golden brown. Don’t let them fully brown or be dark brown.
